Modbus.Title: EL-THCV-MB
Modbus.HintText:
Flush-mounted room sensor with communication interface Flush-mounted design: surface-mounted version on request CompatibleFeller SNAPFIX® Measured variable: Temperature: 0 to 50°C Measured variable: relative humidity: 0 to 100 % Measured variable: CO2: 400 to 2000 ppm Measurand: mixed gases VOC: 0 to 5000 ppm RS-485 interface for Modbus RTU Version: V2.1 Protection class: IP20
